mechanism: Tobramycin-induced nephrotoxicity may impair cyclobenzaprine clearance and increase CNS depression risk in renally compromised patients; cyclobenzaprine may mask early signs of aminoglycoside ototoxicity through CNS depression.
action: Monitor renal function closely; assess for signs of ototoxicity independent of CNS effects; consider alternative to tobramycin if possible or adjust cyclobenzaprine dosing based on renal status.
